recommended-skills.purpose: Optional skills that strengthen Compass phases. Compass works without any of them. scripts/skills-check.sh reports which ones are installed; install a missing skill only with developer approval.
recommended-skills.rule: Keep one skill element per line with name, source, and phase attributes. The element text says what the skill adds.
A project can add its own recommended skills in docs/process/recommended-skills.xml using the same format.
recommended-skills.skill: Explores intent and options before design.
Turns an approved design into a written slice plan.
Finds the root cause before a fix.
Requires evidence before work is called done.
Keeps one source of truth for repeated logic.
